articles.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
articles.snippet: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

articles.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
articles.snippet: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

articles.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
articles.snippet: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

articles.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

articles.title: Anthropic Makes IPO Filing Public, Plans Nasdaq Listing Under ‘ANT’
articles.snippet: The S-1 shows revenue up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a share structure that leaves a trust and the co-founders in control.
